modules.label: rules
modules.contract: Frozen RuleSet: version, map seed, fixed tick, recipes, capacities, bootstrap, legal actions and mission; reject missing mandatory numeric values.
modules.interface: RuleSet -> validated contract or unresolved fields
modules.failure: Changing rules invalidates incompatible traces; no implicit defaults.

test.obligation: Reject incomplete recipes and unversioned rule changes.

mission.acceptance: Reject incomplete recipes and unversioned rule changes.

modules.label: simulation
modules.contract: Only owner of canonical GameState; step takes ordered commands and advances one fixed tick, returning state and events without DOM, network or wall clock.
modules.interface: step(state, commands, rules) -> state, events, rejections
modules.failure: Rejected command cannot mutate state; tie breaks use frozen IDs/order.

test.obligation: Same state and commands give identical state; render frequency cannot alter outcome.

mission.acceptance: Same state and commands give identical state; render frequency cannot alter outcome.

modules.label: economy
modules.contract: Finite stock, cargo, storage, work in process, outputs and incorporated construction materials; explicit recipe accounting and bounded inventories.
modules.interface: applyEconomicEffects(state, effects, rules) -> state or rejection
modules.failure: Reserve then deliver then consume once; overflow waits; depletion stops harvest.

test.obligation: Competing workers cannot take the last unit twice; construction fails without delivered inputs.

mission.acceptance: Competing workers cannot take the last unit twice; construction fails without delivered inputs.

modules.label: transport
modules.contract: Road graph, bounded queues, carrier cargo, route ID and persisted waypoint; explicit last-mile policy and base-to-sawmill deliveries.
modules.interface: advanceTransport(state, rules) -> transfer effects and progress
modules.failure: Disconnected/changed route emits blocked state or explicit reroute; never teleports cargo.

test.obligation: Connected path advances without oscillation; blocked routes conserve cargo; base supplies sawmill.

mission.acceptance: Connected path advances without oscillation; blocked routes conserve cargo; base supplies sawmill.

modules.label: replay
modules.contract: Full command stream, accepted/rejected results, initial state, versions, checkpoints and canonical hashes; UI messages are only a projection.
modules.interface: record(run); replay(initial, commands, rules) -> canonical state hash
modules.failure: Version/hash mismatch stops verification; correction is an appended event.

test.obligation: Truncation, tampering and incompatible rules rejected; replay final state equals execution.

mission.acceptance: Truncation, tampering and incompatible rules rejected; replay final state equals execution.

modules.label: judge
modules.contract: Independently derive mission outcome and metric vector from replayed state; compare matched inputs without self-reported success.
modules.interface: judge(trace, mission) -> evidence verdict and metrics
modules.failure: Missing evidence is UNVERIFIED; invalid replay cannot award completion.

test.obligation: False completion claim rejected; road/direct trials share exact starting world and rule version.

mission.acceptance: False completion claim rejected; road/direct trials share exact starting world and rule version.

modules.label: regions
modules.contract: Minimal pixel world topology and seven explicit production profiles; forests favor wood, fertile land food; exports/imports reference canonical resources.
modules.interface: RegionProfile and adjacency -> regional production modifiers
modules.failure: Profile numbers unresolved until frozen; fictional telemetry labeled fictional.

test.obligation: Regional advantages match profiles; topology/resource IDs valid; render observes same map.

mission.acceptance: Regional advantages match profiles; topology/resource IDs valid; render observes same map.

modules.label: sustainability
modules.contract: Food stocks, population demand and forest regeneration are tick-accounted flows; preservation limits explicit.
modules.failure: Starvation/depletion/renewal have explicit states; regeneration is recorded source, not hidden minting.

test.obligation: Food balance and harvesting limits; zero food and exhausted forest have declared consequences.

mission.acceptance: Food balance and harvesting limits; zero food and exhausted forest have declared consequences.

modules.label: membership
modules.contract: Stable authenticated principal, city/community membership, region ownership, rights and checkpoint recovery; identity provider remains unbound.
modules.failure: Unauthorized mutation denied; historical actor IDs survive membership changes.

test.obligation: Cross-territory writes denied; restart restores same checkpoint; shared-city permissions checked.

mission.acceptance: Cross-territory writes denied; restart restores same checkpoint; shared-city permissions checked.

modules.label: world
modules.contract: One authoritative command ordering across cities; finite stock reservation, physical trade transit and exactly-once delivery effects.
modules.interface: submit(commandId, expectedVersion, actor, payload) -> ordered result
modules.failure: Duplicate retries return prior result; stale commands revalidate/reject; disconnect does not duplicate cargo.

test.obligation: Concurrent stock claims cannot overspend; retries cannot mint; cities agree on ordered checkpoint.

mission.acceptance: Concurrent stock claims cannot overspend; retries cannot mint; cities agree on ordered checkpoint.

modules.label: contributions
modules.contract: Mission binds semantic IDs, exact source/config diff and independent evidence; upgrade only after review and compatible migration.
modules.failure: Self-awards rejected; incompatible upgrades return to Seed diff and reprojection.

test.obligation: Changing strategy changes controlled outcome; invalid proof cannot qualify upgrade.

mission.acceptance: Changing strategy changes controlled outcome; invalid proof cannot qualify upgrade.

modules.label: recognition
modules.contract: Append-only founder/route monuments, civic titles and era seals point to accepted contribution IDs; title criteria frozen.
modules.failure: Event uniqueness prevents duplicate awards; corrections preserve historical record.

test.obligation: Forged awards rejected; repeated attribution idempotent; old era seals cannot be newly fabricated.

mission.acceptance: Forged awards rejected; repeated attribution idempotent; old era seals cannot be newly fabricated.

modules.label: provenance
modules.contract: Regional records carry origin, game/real classification, correction chain and evidence; external utility remains ACE unresolved.
modules.failure: Game events cannot become real-world observations by relabeling.

test.obligation: Missing provenance rejected; corrections preserve prior record and link replacement.

mission.acceptance: Missing provenance rejected; corrections preserve prior record and link replacement.

modules.label: observer
modules.contract: Read-only snapshot consumed by existing Canvas/React shell; local input sends commands; animation may not mutate rules or state.
modules.failure: Stale snapshot is display-only; rendering cannot mint resources or award success.

test.obligation: Observer does not mutate canonical state; UI command replay equals headless command replay.

mission.acceptance: Observer does not mutate canonical state; UI command replay equals headless command replay.

selection.basis: Explicit maintainability preference for modular code; deterministic one-contract/one-path expansion. No measured effort/cost dominance over RP1.

challengers.reason: canonical transition remains tied to frame/wall clock

selection.implementation_permission: planned bindings only; gameplay not implemented by this projection

open_gaps.reason: Data customer/use case and external utility test absent; fictional game events are not real regional observations.
Existing Trajecta novelty definition and judge remain unvalidated.
Player engagement and recognition incentives unmeasured.
Effort, runtime costs and provider alternatives not calibrated.
Identity + utility + recognition increases retention; test with players. The design's 40% delivery gain is illustrative, not measured.
Freeze recipes, region yields, trade rules, monument/title criteria and era boundaries.

global_invariants.rule: Source presence is not gameplay verification; partial old capabilities are not admitted as complete.
Finite stocks conserve units across trees, carriers, inventories, work in process and outputs.
All participants observe the same ordered state; client input cannot mint resources or self-award recognition.
Minimal pixel visual; region resources reflect frozen region profiles.
Player-earned materials must fund construction beyond a documented finite bootstrap.
Historical recognition is permanent and grounded in contribution evidence; title criteria, era admission and community rights require explicit contracts.
